doc: I82 prereg sidecar (= I46a; contract: rules A1-A9 of the docstring of tests_m3/test_blind.py), fixed at the prereg, before any blind outcome exists. holon report (holon/report.py) reads it with the repository's data to generate spec/M3/appendixA_map.json, the map from whitepaper section 11's ids (O1-O37, D1-D9, N1-N4), Appendix A's F1-F14 and the section 11.8 rows to mechanized law ids, and docs/M3_COMPARISON.md. What is generated (rules A3-A6): links from the maps_to of the laws and records, from spec/ledger/maps_to.json (frozen M0 IR cannot carry maps_to), from the back-test tables (an M3 law that a back-test pairs with an M0 or M1 law inherits that law's links), and from the section 11.8 law names (rule A5). What this file adds is what no committed data derives: (1) sets, the record sets compared and their basis (hand: hand-written facts; code: facts extracted from the pinned code); (2) backtests, the back-test tables and the keys their rows use; (3) links, each written only where a committed text written before the law's outcome (its iteration's prereg claim or BUILD_PLAN section) names the item for that law, or names the law as the analogue of a law already linked to it; expect is the status that agrees with the whitepaper's manual result as that text states it, null for a law the text relates to the item only as context (shown, never counted); (4) overrides, which replace the expect of a generated link where the generic rule (D: PROVED; O outside DISCH: REFUTED) misreads the law's role. Sources considered and contributing nothing: I48's corpus (spec/eval/corpus.json) holds no Morph entry (its collectors excluded Scroll and Morph material), so it gives no link. Laws no link reaches are listed as unmapped by the generator, never dropped. Every law id here is data: holon/report.py names none.
